title: Tech Note: 4D for Android: Computed Attributes and More
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Largely obsolete as a product path: the 4D for Android / 4D Mobile app-generation product line covered here was discontinued by 4D, so this specific mobile-project-editor workflow no longer applies to current 4D versions, even though the underlying computed-attributes/ORDA concepts remain valid.
related_updates: 4D discontinued the native 4D for iOS/Android mobile app generator product line; 4D's current mobile/web strategy centers on Qodly Studio and responsive ORDA/REST-based web apps rather than generating native Android/iOS apps from within 4D.

The computed-attributes technique itself (exposed getter functions on {Table}Entity classes) remains valid ORDA/4D syntax and is documented in the companion note (TN 22-02); only the Android-specific mobile-project tooling shown here is gone.
